gaps.sentence: You risk ___ your licence if you drink and drive.
She forgot ___ the email, so she sent it twice.
gaps.explanation: forget + -ing = lose the memory of a past action (she did send it).

gaps.sentence: They can't help ___ at his impression of the boss.
gaps.explanation: can't help + -ing = can't stop yourself: can't help laughing.

gaps.sentence: Don't forget ___ the plants while we're away.
gaps.explanation: forget + to-infinitive = fail to do something you should do.

gaps.sentence: I'd prefer ___ at home rather than go out.
gaps.explanation: would prefer + to-infinitive: I'd prefer to eat. (prefer + -ing for general likes.)

gaps.sentence: I can't afford ___ another month abroad.
She was on the verge of ___ up her job to sail around the world.
gaps.explanation: 'On the verge of' ends in a preposition, so the gerund follows.
